learned_selector: Product title anchors under h2.title-link-wrapper--25--s, with a[href] fallback; retain only item.rakuten.co.jp/{shop}/{item}/ URLs. This excludes ad redirect hosts, store pages, and search/category URLs.
operation_rule: Collect product links while the search results are open, deduplicate by item URL without query/fragment, then save up to max_items. Scroll at most six times when needed; save navigates to each detail page.
assumptions_and_limits: Uses the observed item-host/two-path-segment product URL structure. Variant query parameters are retained from the observed link; no SKU or price is extracted.
